Goal! Banfield 0, Atlético Tucumán 2. Juan Rodríguez (Atlético Tucumán) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Lautaro Godoy with a cross following a set piece situation.
Juan Infante (Atlético Tucumán) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tomás Adoryán (Banfield) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Renzo Tesuri (Atlético Tucumán).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Banfield 0, Atlético Tucumán 2.
Substitution, Banfield. Lautaro Villegas replaces Brandon Oviedo.
Substitution, Banfield. Alexander Machado replaces Juan Luis Alfaro.
Substitution, Banfield. Santiago López García replaces David Zalazar.
Second Half begins Banfield 0, Atlético Tucumán 2.
Goal! Banfield 1, Atlético Tucumán 2. Alexander Machado (Banfield) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tomás Adoryán.
Substitution, Banfield. Lisandro Piñero replaces Federico Medina.
